ctx.x: The very first band that we had together… [unintelligible] the younger guys like Scovall Brown, Ed Burke and Willie Randall, we were all rehearsing, having our rehearsal thing. We had a guy in the band, Ace Vant was his name and he was the worst musician of all of us. He really couldn‟t play. He had a trombone and he wasn‟t very good at it. We were rehearsing at my house because there was always a piano there. So my house is the rehearsal and we rehearsed. This guy goes downtown to the Chicago Theater and tells a…
